_comment: Prices Langfuse uses to work out the cost of a model call, in US dollars per million tokens.
Each price is copied from the provider's own pricing page, named beside it, and from nowhere else.
If a price cannot be confirmed there, leave the model out: Langfuse then shows its tokens and no cost.
Applied by `task langfuse:prices` (prices.sh). Cached-token prices are not set: no call here uses the prompt cache.

models.sourceRow: Claude Sonnet 5.5: Base input tokens $2 / MTok, Output tokens $10 / MTok
Claude Haiku 4.5: Base input tokens $1 / MTok, Output tokens $5 / MTok
